notes: Libretto by Francesco Maria Piave (1853). Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score (gioje, perchè, nè). IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ, intervocalic s voiced. Translation literal, for meaning; written for this app.

phrases.original: Flora, amici, la notte che resta
phrases.translation: Flora, friends, the night that remains
phrases.ipa: ˈflɔ.ra aˈmi.tʃi la ˈnɔt.te ke ˈrɛ.sta

phrases.translation: make it shine here with other joys…

phrases.original: Fra le tazze più viva è la festa...
phrases.translation: Among the cups the party is livelier…
phrases.ipa: fra le ˈtat.tse pju ˈvi.va‿ɛ la ˈfɛ.sta

phrases.translation: I want it so;

phrases.original: al piacere m'affido, ed io soglio con tal farmaco i mali sopir.
phrases.translation: I give myself to pleasure, and with such a remedy I am wont to soothe my ills.
phrases.ipa: al pjaˈtʃe.re mafˈfi.do‿ed ˈi.o ˈsɔʎ.ʎo kon tal ˈfar.ma.ko‿i ˈma.li soˈpir

phrases.original: Mio Visconte, mercè di tal dono.
phrases.translation: My Viscount, thank you for such a gift.
phrases.ipa: ˈmi.o visˈkon.te merˈtʃɛ di tal ˈdo.no

phrases.translation: Is everything ready?…
My dears, sit down;

phrases.original: è al convito che s'apre ogni cor.
phrases.translation: it is at the feast that every heart opens.
phrases.ipa: ɛ al konˈvi.to ke ˈsa.pre‿ˈoɲ.ɲi kɔr

phrases.original: È al convito che s'apre ogni cor.
phrases.translation: It is at the feast that every heart opens.
phrases.ipa: ɛ al konˈvi.to ke ˈsa.pre‿ˈoɲ.ɲi kɔr

phrases.translation: Are you joking?
Stop it.
I am nothing to him…
Is it true, then?…
why so?
I do not understand it.
I give you my thanks.
You, Baron, did not do as much…

phrases.original: Ed ei solo da qualche minuto.
phrases.translation: And he only for a few minutes.
phrases.ipa: ed ˈe.i ˈso.lo da ˈkwal.ke miˈnu.to

phrases.translation: I shall be Hebe who pours…
Let us drink, let us drink.
Yes, yes, a toast.
Yes.
Yes, listen to the singer
And will you be able to enjoy it?

phrases.original: Sì, la vita s'addoppia al gioir, sì, la vita s'addoppia al gioir.
phrases.translation: Yes, life is doubled by rejoicing, yes, life is doubled by rejoicing.
phrases.ipa: si la ˈvi.ta sadˈdop.pja‿al dʒoˈir si la ˈvi.ta sadˈdop.pja‿al dʒoˈir

phrases.translation: Well said…

phrases.original: le cure segrete fuga sempre l'amico licor.
phrases.translation: friendly wine always chases away secret cares.

phrases.translation: It would have been better if you had kept quiet.
Why?…

phrases.original: A me invece simpatico egli è.
phrases.translation: I, on the other hand, like him.

Marquis…

phrases.translation: Yes, it is true.

phrases.original: E ch'io bramo immortal come quella.
phrases.translation: And I long for it to be immortal, like that one.
Let us drink, let us drink.
Inspiration does not smile on me…
Would it please you?
Yes?…
I already have it in my heart.

phrases.original: In Alfredo Germont, o signora, ecco un altro che molto v'onora;
phrases.translation: In Alfredo Germont, madam, here is another who greatly honours you;
phrases.ipa: in alˈfre.do dʒerˈmɔnt o siɲˈɲo.ra‿ˈɛk.ko‿un ˈal.tro ke ˈmol.to voˈno.ra

phrases.original: pochi amici a lui simili sono.
phrases.translation: few friends are like him.

phrases.original: T'ho detto: l'amistà qui s'intreccia al diletto.
phrases.translation: I told you: here friendship is entwined with pleasure.
phrases.ipa: tɔ ˈdet.to la.misˈta kwi sinˈtret.tʃa‿al diˈlɛt.to

phrases.translation: Well said…

phrases.translation: Alfredo thinks of you all the time.

phrases.original: Egra foste, e ogni dì con affanno qui volò, di voi chiese...
phrases.translation: You were ill, and every day he flew here anxiously and asked after you…
phrases.ipa: ˈɛ.gra ˈfo.ste‿e‿ˈoɲ.ɲi di kon afˈfan.no kwi voˈlɔ di voi ˈkjɛ.ze

phrases.translation: I am not deceiving you…

phrases.original: E tu dunque non apri più bocca?
phrases.translation: And you, then, won't you open your mouth any more?
phrases.ipa: e tu ˈdun.kwe non ˈa.pri pju ˈbok.ka

phrases.translation: Let us drink.
Let us drink, let us drink.

phrases.original: O Barone, nè un verso, nè un viva troverete in quest' ora giuliva?..

phrases.translation: Then it's up to you…
And aren't you a master at it?
Yes, listen to the singer
